entry_points.text: Early pid validates limit scaling by CPUs with log preparing idr/cache and registering caches/sysctls/tree; sysctl register fatal teardown frees when present; last-pid shows cursor-1 advancing with caps; memfd admin-gated clamping to parent scope storing on success.

Pidfd open/getfd reject bad flags/ids/empty, translate with temp ref installing cloexec then dropping; profile tick samples non-user IP from irq regs, read gives step then clipped bytes advancing offset, write clears; ns install needs dual priv and ancestor replacing for-children.

Attach handles seize/classic auditing rejecting kernel threads/same-group/exiting/traced linking arming stop waiting notifying; traceme sec-checks parenting unless exiting drops; detach validates signal disables breakpoints assigns exit unlinks notifies; sysfs resolves/delegates missing as errors with perm/safety/lock, version newlines.

Central dispatcher covers memory, options, message, siginfo, mask, interrupt/listen, detach, resume CONT/SYSCALL/SINGLESTEP, kill, regset, syscall observe/mutate, seccomp, rseq, dispatch; default fails; mask exact dropping unblockable and deferral; interrupt traps cancelling listen, listen parks until notify.

exports.text: String, bool family, array and fixed-string publish const ops tables; render emits text with newline, Y/N letters or comma joins, release drops allocations.
Module param sysfs setup publishes visible params per module, removal withdraws groups and frees bookkeeping, destroy runs per-param release without sysfs.

Pid lookup under RCU with ref plus numeric/iterate helpers; pidfd dup uses exec lock and ptrace perm mapping exiting to no-process else bad-fd; VM pins mm, checks perm, delegates copy; ns get/put/owner/parent with vectors.

Tracer moves bulk/word memory forced with distinct failures, transfers regsets by note requiring multiple-of-size with clamp, exports siginfo with zeroed slack and admin-gated classic filters by ordinal with length probe.

hazards.text: Errors map to no-space, no-memory, invalid, read-only, perm, IO, no-process, bad-fd, fault, range, denied, medium-type preserving progress; early string borrows caller memory; wide offsets empty with compat conversion and yield on signals.

Array overwrites separators needing writable input with staging tolerating short results; adding invisible and boot group failures plus primary TID transfer fatal with cleanup; spurious exec-stop on pid mismatch; frozen/listening/fatal refused.
Render uses Y/N swapped for inverted with newline page bounds; profiling uses shift three size eight; syscall discriminators cover NONE/ENTRY/EXIT/SECCOMP with ENTRY/EXIT message tags.

invariants.text: Install rejects overlong strings borrowing when early alloc absent else dups; absent bool true; enable-only rejects true to false; inverted negates; array enforces min/max stride with lock check; fixed checks capacity.

Initial pid ref one empty level zero number zero; initial ns adding idle reaper; bounds reserved plus one to limit; ns_last_pid world-writable int 0 to max, memfd_noexec 0644 int 0 to 2; vm registers or no-ops.
Profiling entries pair PC with count, state holds atomic buffer, length, shift and enabled; accounts only on mode match with buffer scaling by shift when inside; weak timer setup fails invalid.

Link needs empty entry then parents and refs creds; options validate mask replacing only O_MASK band and gate suspend-seccomp on build/priv/mode/clear; spurious on trap versus virt pid mismatch; steps need arch; attach may show transient running.

Retained siginfo needs stored details under sighand; peek validates flags/count/offset with SHARED selector and skips in chosen queue of linked entries; syscall observe reports full extent, mutate needs full record rejecting future bits/kind change preserving width.

locks.text: Pid cache array indexed by level serializes via mutex; dedicated cache-aligned spinlock guards identifier allocation maps.

Pid mutation needs tasklist write with safe swap ordering and cached numbers; attach check holds read lock validating traced-by-current with optional freeze then requires inactive traced/frozen unless skipped.

Tracer access needs ptrace parent plus dumpable or caps under RCU; wakeup needs signal lock marking pending and kicking; freeze refuses listening/spurious/fatal setting flag, unfreeze clears and drops traced on fatal with wake.

state_machines.text: Param group starts empty growing container/pointers per add with null termination and fixed group/set/core names; writability fixed at creation; kobject lookup-or-create refs; builtin skips invisible splitting at dot; init orders set, version, params.

Pidfd creation prepares file then installs descriptor; ns destroy unregisters, frees, destroys idr and defers via RCU/work walking parents to initial; reboot ignores initial else selects hangup/interrupt under tasklist signalling reaper with kill.

Attach stop sends privileged stop except seize converting stopped to trapped with flags and wake; resume validates signal, publishes status, clears TRACED marking, selects plain/block/single/emulated stepping and wakes.

structs.text: Param sysfs pairs module attr with descriptor; container holds count, group and flex pairs plus null-terminated shadow; dispatch joins show/store, uevent filter/ops, kset, release and type.
Pid sysctl root supplies lookup, permission and ownership handlers; max entry points at initial max with int length, owner-write mode and min-max handler tied to global bounds.

Regset view arrays note id, count, size and callbacks; retrieval clamps to capacity, zeroes staging when absent, delegates and frees on fail reporting produced bytes; siginfo adds zeroed expansion slack.

Syscall record holds discriminator, arch, IP/SP plus entry number/args, exit value/error or seccomp view with message; rseq holds pointer, length, signature and zero flags with truncation reporting full extent.
